t: A machine that transforms $(6)sludge$() into something useful.$(br2)When supplied with $(6)Sludge$(), obtained from the $(l:agriculture_n_husbandry/plant_gatherer)Plant Gatherer$(), it will generate $(6)something$().$(br)This process requires $(6)1000$()RF/t though so be sure to have some power stored.
一台能把 $(6)污泥$() 变成有用东西的机器。$(br2)当输入由 $(l:agriculture_n_husbandry/plant_gatherer)植物收割机$() 产生的 $(6)污泥$() 时，它会生成 $(6)某种东西$()。$(br)不过该过程需要 $(6)1000$()RF/t，所以请确保储备足够的电力。
